resources.string: No cameras configured.\nPress SETTINGS (or the MENU key on the remote) to add RTSP cameras.

Examples:
Hikvision: rtsp://admin:PASS@192.168.1.64:554/Streaming/Channels/101
Dahua / CP Plus: rtsp://admin:PASS@192.168.1.108:554/cam/realmonitor?channel=1&subtype=0
Special characters in the password (@ # : /) must be URL-encoded, e.g. @ → %40
Use {ch} where the channel number goes.\nHikvision NVR: rtsp://admin:PASS@IP:554/Streaming/Channels/{ch}01\nDahua / CP Plus NVR: rtsp://admin:PASS@IP:554/cam/realmonitor?channel={ch}&subtype=0
